description: This file contains integration tests for the OrderRepository, specifically testing the retrieval of an order by ID in the eShopOnWeb project. It sets up an in-memory database, adds a test order, and verifies that the order can be retrieved correctly.

classes.name: GetById
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying the OrderRepository's GetByIdAsync method. Sets up in-memory database and contains tests for retrieving existing orders.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test class, setting up the in-memory database and the repository.
